objective: Agents execute registered Flow files; missing Flow disables new calls; runtime prompt and declared parameters remain separate.

requirements.requirement: Agent references any registered published Flow without reverse Agent declarations or source-path coupling
checks: Deterministic execution without a model
Actual plugin catalog used for custom Flow availability
Direct, nested and parameter-set Flow invocation

requirements.requirement: Deleting the referenced file disables new calls and restoration rechecks availability
checks: Agent source bytes unchanged
Read-only availability delivered to configuration snapshots
Disabled picker and send button preserve user input
Recovery restores availability
Deletion closes an unsubmitted parameter form

requirements.requirement: Runtime prompt and other parameters are supported
checks: Readonly input.prompt, optional mutable vars.prompt initialized from input
Flow defaults then Agent defaults then runtime override
Typed validation before durable acceptance
Image assets persisted through the runtime form
Per-run connection and slot binding overrides
Literal template-like user text is never reinterpreted

requirements.requirement: Published changes apply to subsequent calls while existing accepted requests retain their definitions
checks: Latest published revision without rewriting Agent
Optional pinned revision
Unpublished incomplete drafts do not disable a valid published definition
Host restart after deleting source and external Flow dependencies still executes accepted snapshots

requirements.requirement: Runtime configuration and durability preserve admitted choices and report failures precisely
checks: Tier edits retain the admitted model in direct, nested and batch calls
Provider or protocol changes reject before any model request
Missing or corrupt required snapshots fail closed
Frozen execution settings participate in queue merge compatibility
Admission failures retain specific diagnostics without prompt or parameter bodies

validation.scope: Actual Flow Agent execution and connection identity tests
UI Flow Agent form and settings additions
CLI parameter calls and actual SIGKILL recovery regression

executionSemantics.flowUpdate: New calls follow latest published revision unless explicitly pinned; drafts do not change execution.
executionSemantics.queueSnapshot: Selected Agent, Flow source and external Flow closure, arguments, default bindings and safe connection selection are frozen at acceptance.
executionSemantics.indirectResources: Other Agent, Skill and Prompt references inside Flow retain the existing resolution and freezing boundary at actual Run construction.
executionSemantics.authorization: Credentials are never snapshotted; live connection availability, authorization and selected-model capabilities are rechecked.
executionSemantics.recovery: Accepted instructions and running graphs survive Flow source deletion; new calls are blocked.

deployment: Workspace implementation and local verification only; no deployment or publishing was performed.
